posts.title: Pingway v2.0 — Manage Pingway in your browser!
posts.summary: Pingway now has a website: log in with Discord to manage server and personal settings. Plus rebuilt market alerts, personal Data Centers, a /status redesign, website security and lots of fixes.
posts.body:
## 🌐 Manage Pingway in your browser!
Pingway now has a website: **https://pingway.vercel.app**
Log in with Discord and manage everything without typing commands:
- **Server settings** (Manage Server): notification channel, release event countdown, AI assistant channels, ScionDex channel, raid & logger Google Sheets.
- **Personal settings** (every server): Data Centers, market price alerts, server status alerts, IGN character card, Firmament reminders.
- One-click invite, light and dark mode, works on phones.

## 🔒 Website security
The dashboard was built and tested with security first:
- Official **Login with Discord** with forgery protection; your login is stored in an **encrypted, secure cookie**.
- Every change is **re-checked with Discord** against your real permissions — you can only change servers where you have *Manage Server*, and only your own personal settings.
- Choosing the release ping role needs *Manage Roles*, and **only safe roles** can be picked (no admin/moderator roles), so nobody can trick the bot into handing out powerful roles.
- Release times can't be set in the past (no ping spam), and `@everyone`/`@here` pings are removed from event names.
- Protection against cross-site attacks, script injection, clickjacking and database injection; rate limits; logged-out or stolen logins stop working.
- No secrets are ever sent to your browser. Checked with 48 automated security tests and an independent code review.

## 🤖 AI is opt-in per channel
AI is only used in channels where a server admin turned it on with `/ailistenhere`. Slash commands, buttons, DMs, alerts and the website never use AI, and Pingway's database is never shared with any AI company. Details in the updated Privacy Policy.

## 💰 Market alerts, rebuilt
- Fixed: the live Universalis feed now connects properly (alerts had stopped working).
- Alerts only for listings **at least 80% below the usual price**.
- "Usual price" = **median of the last 7 days of real sales** on the Data Center, so troll sales (1 gil / millions) can't fake it.
- New double-check against the **next 3 cheapest listings from other sellers**: only real pricing mistakes get through.
- NQ and HQ checked separately.
- **Grouped DMs every 5 minutes** (up to 10 items per message) in an aligned table: lowest price first, grouped by Data Center.

## 🌐 Data Centers are now personal
`/datacenter` is saved **per user** and works in every server. `/price` and market alerts both use it. (Your old choice keeps working until you save a new one.)

## 🌍 `/status` redesign
- Opens straight to your saved Data Center and tracked world.
- Browsing another Data Center no longer changes the world you track.
- New **Exit** button. New users start with DM alerts **off**.

## 🛠️ Fixes & stability
- Crash safety net: unexpected errors are logged instead of stopping the bot.
- Release event admin buttons fixed (they errored for admins).
- Undeliverable reminders stop retrying after 5 attempts.
- Maintenance mode no longer errors on autocomplete.
- The AI no longer replies while you type a Party Finder name in `/pf`.
- Updated to current discord.js options (no more deprecation warnings).
- Slash commands only re-register when they change.
- `/marketalert` simplified: it now uses your `/datacenter` choices.

## 📄 Other
- Source code is now public under **AGPL-3.0** so anyone can check that Pingway is safe.
- Updated **Privacy Policy** and **Terms of Service**, and a new **Security Policy**.

Thank you for using Pingway! 💜 Support: https://discord.gg/DDdV48X4G2 · Ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/riverzola
